purpose: Fresh non-parent canary for the canonical astra_runtime mission-file entrypoint. Force an unbound Python-library CBOR capability so autonomous PyPI acquisition must receive a valid canonical origin mission path.
goal: Create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/MISSION_ORIGIN_CBOR_CANARY_SOURCE.json containing exactly three records with fields id and text: 1 alpha, 2 beta, 3 gamma. Using a zero-cost Python library, encode those exact records as CBOR and save canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/MISSION_ORIGIN_CBOR_CANARY_OUTPUT.cbor. Using that Python library, independently decode the CBOR artifact and verify the decoded records are exactly identical to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/MISSION_ORIGIN_CBOR_CANARY_SOURCE.json in values, order, field names, and record count.
